name: When should engineer coordination begin on a construction project?

mainEntity.name: When should engineer coordination begin on a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engineer coordination should ideally begin during the design phase of a project, even before construction starts. Early involvement allows for proactive identification and resolution of potential conflicts between different engineering systems. Delaying coordination can lead to costly redesigns and schedule disruptions once construction is underway. Engaging us early helps to streamline the entire process from conceptualization to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engineer coordination should begin during the design phase to proactively identify and resolve potential conflicts.
